name: Favored Prestige Class (Mythic)
body:
You gain the maximum advantage from the prestigious path you chose.

Prerequisite(s): Favored Prestige Class.

Benefit(s): You gain both 1 hit point and 1 skill point per level when you gain a level in the prestige class you selected. You may replace one of these benefits with a favored class bonus if that class grants one. In addition, you can always take 10 or 20 on checks of the skill you selected with this feat’s nonmythic version, even when you are rushed or threatened.
